starter.name: Forager
starter.summary: Quick hands and a big bag. Wakes with a basket and an axe. Wears patched clothes; fine attire is earned through valley achievements.
intro: You wake in the grass by the river, a basket on your arm and an axe at your belt.
Herbs grow on the bank to the west. Pick a few before the day gets on.
The bridge to the east is broken. The valley waits on the other side.
